context: Two friends plan a culture-packed Sunday
purpose: Teach: 月刊/ショート/禁煙/陸上/都心/音楽家/壮大/熱狂

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今月の月刊誌、注目の音楽家特集が壮大なの。
lines.en: This month's magazine has this amazing feature on musicians—it's really grand.
lines.style: Bright and immediate opening. Leans forward with genuine enthusiasm. Light, quick pace. Shares the discovery like she's already imagining going together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。日曜、都心まで遠征する?
lines.en: That sounds great. Should we head into the city on Sunday?
lines.style: Warm and inviting. Not a question mark at the end—more a gentle proposal. Soft eyes. Easy tone that makes it feel like it was already half-decided.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。陸上競技の中継も、午前は熱狂的だって。
lines.en: Yeah. And apparently the track meet in the morning is supposed to be incredible.
lines.style: Quick momentum. Animated but not scattered—she's genuinely caught up in the possibility. Each detail lands. No breathiness, just honest excitement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店、禁煙だから、ゆっくり過ごせるよ。
lines.en: The café is no-smoking, so we can take our time and just be there.
lines.style: Quiet assurance underneath. Gentle tempo. She's offering permission to linger without making it sound like a big deal. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ショートヘアにしてみた、変?
lines.en: I got my hair cut short—does it look weird?
lines.style: Vulnerable opening. Small, genuine ask. Eyes checking. Slight hesitation before 'weird.' Needs honest feedback, not flattery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Not at all. It really suits you.
lines.style: Immediate, no hesitation. Warm and sure. Locks eye contact. The kind of reassurance that lands because it comes without performance—just true.
